title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.19366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). translated_title: 看见、维护与学习：多模态智能体记忆的演进
translated_abstract: 多模态模型与智能体的出现，使AI系统能够通过整合跨多种模态的信息，更接近人类地从真实世界中学习并与之交互。然而，随着多模态智能体迈向长时程任务和终身学习场景，如何使其能够持续从复杂、异构的多模态数据中获取有用信息仍然是一个重大挑战。应对这一挑战需要有效的记忆机制，该机制能够在会话之间保持连续性、适应不断变化的用户和环境，并通过积累的经验来改进记忆管理策略。我们引入了一个面向多模态智能体记忆的双轴分析框架，该框架围绕两个关键问题构建：多模态信息如何形成和表示（轴一：形成与表示），以及其管理如何随积累的经验而适应（轴二：记忆管理）。轴一“形成与表示”……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个双轴分析框架，从多模态信息的形成与表示、以及基于积累经验的自适应记忆管理两个维度，系统性地梳理了多模态智能体记忆的研究演进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory, structured around how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I) and how memory management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II).
